TypeofUnits.title: TypeofUnits
TypeofUnits.description: The customer's preferred unit size. Valid options: 2BHK, 3BHK, 4BHK, Above 4BHK. This is optional; user can skip.

varAge.title: varAge
varAge.description: The age of the customer for demographic profiling. This is optional.

varBudget.title: varBudget
varBudget.description: The customer's budget range. Valid options: 2-3 Cr, 3-4 Cr, 4-5 Cr, 5-6 Cr, 6-7 Cr, 7-8 Cr, 8-9 Cr, 9-10 Cr, 10-11 Cr, 11-12 Cr, 12 Cr & Above. This is optional

varDesiredStatus.title: varDesiredStatus
varDesiredStatus.description: Construction status preference. Valid options: Ready-to-move-in, Under Construction, Nearing Completion, Pre-Launch. This is optional.

varFirstName.title: varFirstName
varFirstName.description: The first name of the potential buyer.(Required)

varInterestSiteVisit.title: varInterestSiteVisit
varInterestSiteVisit.description: Set to True if the customer expresses immediate interest in visiting a site.

varLastName.title: varLastName
varLastName.description: The last name of the potential buyer. (Required)

varLeadSource.title: varLeadSource
varLeadSource.description: The source of the lead (e.g., Web, Walk-in, Referral)

varPhone.title: varPhone
varPhone.description: The primary contact phone number for the customer. (Required)

varProject.title: varProject
varProject.description: The specific residential project of interest. Valid options: Varthur Vista, Yalahanka Yard, Miyapur Manor, Banjara Beam, Saket Square, Rohini Rise. (Required)

varSourceofFunding.title: varSourceofFunding
varSourceofFunding.description: How the buyer intends to pay. Valid options: Self, Bank. This is optional
